This pathway implies a possible mechanism of action where Permethrin may exert its therapeutic effects through a similar mechanism as Lindane, potentially targeting the same biological pathways involved in the treatment of scabies. The integration of these indications provides a plausible route for repurposing Permethrin, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety in this context.
